desc: Ideate candidate approaches and identify exact big-int convolution as the primary route.
Implement the final Python program using base-2^20 integer-multiplication convolution, with memory-efficient input parsing, N<3 early exit, small-N direct fallback, and correct byte/bit offsets.
Verify the implementation on the provided samples (all 3 passed) and review edge cases, offsets, carries, and performance.
